steps.path: The round button left of Send, while a reply is being written
steps.headline: Which stop button looks alive while the assistant works?
steps.changed: The stop button is round now, as you picked. While the assistant works it moves; every few seconds each pane fakes a stuck reply, and the button holds still.
steps.notice: Watch each one for a few loops: the moving part says “working”, the still part says “something is off”. Tap it any time; it stays a stop button.
steps.risk: All three tick in small steps to save battery, so up close none of them is perfectly smooth.

variants.label: Breathing ring
variants.summary: A soft ring grows out of the button and fades, over and over.
variants.measured: One breath every 1.6 s, ring reaches 9 px

variants.label: Circling light
variants.summary: A thin light chases around the outside of the button, like a loading ring around the stop mark.
variants.measured: One lap every 1.2 s, in 16 ticks

variants.label: Slow glow
variants.summary: The button's own glow swells and settles; nothing leaves the button. The calmest of the three.
variants.risk: On Light and Crème, where the button is black, the glow looks more like a soft dark shadow than light.
